headline: Household Resilience, Career Growth & Long-Term Wealth
summary: Balanced guidance on emergency reserves, mid-career mobility, preventative wellness, and neighborhood engagement.

advice.title: Build a 3-to-6 Month Liquid Runway
advice.guidance: Keep household emergency savings in a separate high-liquidity account with automated payday transfers.
advice.actionStep: Verify your emergency fund percentage inside Finance Goals.

advice.title: Quarterly Career & Skill Audit
advice.guidance: Dedicate two hours each quarter to updating certifications, measurable wins, and mentor check-ins.
advice.actionStep: Identify one high-leverage skill to sharpen over the next 90 days.

advice.title: Protect Daily Recovery Blocks
advice.guidance: Consistent 30-minute movement and screen-free meals improve cognitive stamina for work and family alike.
advice.actionStep: Schedule three recurring wellness blocks on your weekly calendar.
